title: down alternative mattress cover
text: down alternative mattress cover. I purchased this to go on an aerobed, hoping it would make it a bit more comfortable.  The first person who used the bed said it was super comfortable.  Now, whether this was from the mattress topper or the bed itself? Who can say, but it doesn't hurt!  It washed/dried nicely and was easy to put on.  It is a down "alternative" so I think it will be useful to take it off the bed and shake it - washing once a week. I haven't "poured" anything on it to check the "water resistance" part... sorry... and we shall see about how long it lasts!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
